purpose: Record the stopped sequence of prospective attempts to quantitatively emulate Chapter 1 H1-H4 with Model 3-derived numerical models, without retaining the exploratory emulator implementations on the Chapter 2 mainline.

attempts.name: Model3R-v1
attempts.main_positive: H3 isolation-to-pollen-limitation slope could be reproduced closely in the best candidate.
attempts.failure: Generalization did not increase with isolation across all four contexts and the H4 assurance-to-pollen-limitation association had the wrong sign.

attempts.name: Model3R-v2
attempts.main_positive: Real island covariates and distance/climate-dependent visitor assembly reproduced H3 closely and improved isolation-driven assurance response.
attempts.failure: Selfing-adjusted generalized accessibility remained negative in all four contexts in the best draw and the H4 assurance association retained the wrong sign.

attempts.name: Model3R-v3-assembly
attempts.main_positive: Assembly filtering recovered the empirical negative H4 assurance and generalization associations and reproduced H3 within the declared tolerance.
attempts.failure: The regional H2 isolation slopes for selfing/generalized accessibility were not jointly reproduced; the best draw retained multiple failed regional targets.

attempts.name: Model3E-v1
attempts.provenance: merged historically as PR #387 and removed from the active Chapter 2 surface by the cleanup PR that created this audit
attempts.main_positive: The H1/H3 screen could reproduce positive assurance/accessibility isolation slopes and positive isolation-associated pollen limitation for selected parameter sets.
attempts.failure: Display dulling failed already at training; all five frozen accepted sets then failed the held-out H2/H4 joint rule.

integrated_interpretation.scope_implication: The sequence supports the pre-existing Chapter 2 boundary: Model 3 can reproduce a mechanistically compatible island-syndrome structure, but quantitative transfer to the Chapter 1 macroecological coefficient vector is not established.
integrated_interpretation.why_stop_now: Each model was prospectively frozen, but the sequence changed model structure after observing prior failures. Continuing until one model passes would become open-ended model-family search and would weaken the inferential meaning of later preregistration.
integrated_interpretation.future_work: A multi-species flora-level emulator may be scientifically worthwhile, but it is a separate study. It must disclose this complete failed-model sequence and prospectively freeze the model family and validation targets before execution.

claim_boundary: Do not pool the parameter draws across the four structurally different attempts into one pass/fail denominator.
Do not describe Model 3 as quantitatively reproducing Chapter 1 H1-H4.
Do not reinterpret these failures as evidence that the established Model 3 mechanistic results are false.
Do not continue Chapter 2 by adding mechanisms until an empirical emulation passes.
Do not assign Chapter 1 geographic strata to Model 3 parameter cells.
Any flora-level quantitative emulator is a separate research project rather than a Chapter 2 completion task.
